claim: Patchline ships an incident auto-remediation loop that proposes and verifies a fix before any human is paged. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the auto-remediation claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make incident-auto-remediation-gate`.
